API revenue grew 17% YoY, specialty chemicals increased 92%, while formulations registered strong growth of 58%, supported by higher exports and entry into new markets. • Improving operational efficiencies and backward integration: The Saykha Methylamine facility operated at 72% utilization, with captive consumption for the anti-diabetic portfolio increasing to 85%.

Sector Outlook: Positive Company Outlook & Guidance: Management projects stable near-term API and specialty chemical pricing with FY27 volume growth targeted at 5–10% as inventory normalizes, while sustaining consolidated EBITDA margins around 15% (standalone >14%, formulations in the early- 20% range).

Revenue momentum will be driven by export orders, geographical expansion, and an accelerated Rs 1,000 Cr formulation target powered by oncology, where US revenues are set to ramp up over 3–6 months following an upcoming ANDA approval and 4–5 planned filings, aiming for a 30–40% formulation revenue share by FY30.
